label: moving average
definition: Average of price over N periods, used for trend and trailing stops.

label: exponential moving average
definition: Moving average weighting recent prices more.

label: simple moving average
definition: Unweighted moving average.

label: 8-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 8-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 9-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 9-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 10-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 10-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 20-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 20-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 21-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 21-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 50-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 50-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 100-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 100-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 150-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 150-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: 200-period moving average (type unspecified)
definition: 200-period moving average when EMA/SMA is not stated.

label: volume-weighted average price
definition: Intraday average price weighted by volume.

label: anchored VWAP
definition: VWAP calculated from a chosen anchor date or event.

label: relative strength index
definition: Momentum oscillator of recent gains vs losses.

label: MACD
definition: Difference of two EMAs with a signal line.

label: average true range
definition: Average of true ranges; a volatility measure.

label: Bollinger Bands
definition: Bands N standard deviations around a moving average.

label: Keltner Channel
definition: ATR-based bands around an EMA.

label: Donchian Channel
definition: Highest high and lowest low over N bars.

label: average directional index
definition: Trend strength indicator.

label: stochastic oscillator
definition: Close relative to the recent range.

label: on-balance volume
definition: Cumulative volume signed by price direction.

label: volume profile
definition: Volume traded at each price level.

label: TTM squeeze
definition: Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channel signalling compression.

label: Fibonacci retracement
definition: Retracement levels at Fibonacci ratios.

label: relative strength
definition: Performance of a stock relative to an index or peers (not RSI).

label: RS line
definition: Ratio line of a stock to the index.

label: average volume
definition: Average traded volume over N periods.

label: volume surge
definition: Volume well above its average.

label: volume dry-up
definition: Volume falling well below average inside a base.

label: VIX
definition: CBOE implied volatility index of S&P 500 options.

label: chart pattern
definition: Recognisable price structure.

label: breakout
definition: Price moving above resistance or a range high.

label: breakdown
definition: Price moving below support or a range low.

label: failed breakout
definition: Breakout that reverses back into the range.

label: failed breakdown
definition: Breakdown that reverses back above support.

label: consolidation
definition: Sideways price action after a move.

label: base
definition: Multi-week consolidation before a potential breakout.

label: volatility contraction pattern
definition: Base with successively smaller pullbacks and drying volume.

label: high tight flag
definition: Tight flag after a very large, fast advance.

label: bull flag
definition: Short consolidation sloping against a prior up-move.

label: gap up
definition: Open above the prior close.

label: gap down
definition: Open below the prior close.

label: inside bar
definition: Bar fully within the prior bar's range.

label: pullback
definition: Counter-trend move inside a trend.

label: reclaim
definition: Price moving back above a lost level.

label: first red day
definition: First down day after a multi-day run.

label: opening range
definition: High/low of the first N minutes of the session.

label: support
definition: Price where buying has stopped declines.

label: resistance
definition: Price where selling has stopped advances.

label: inflection level
definition: Price where control between buyers and sellers changed before.

label: liquidity sweep
definition: Move through obvious stops before reversing (SMC/ICT).

label: order block
definition: Last opposing candle before an impulsive move (SMC/ICT).

label: break of structure
definition: Price breaking the last swing in trend direction (SMC).

label: change of character
definition: First break against the prevailing structure (SMC).

label: trading setup
definition: Complete pattern plus trigger used to take trades.

label: episodic pivot
definition: Large gap on a fundamental catalyst that re-rates a stock.

label: opening range breakout
definition: Entry on a break of the opening range high or low.

label: win rate
definition: Share of trades that are winners.

label: R multiple
definition: Profit or loss expressed in units of initial risk.

label: expectancy
definition: Average R per trade.

label: average daily range percent
definition: Average daily high-low range as a percent of price, usually 20 days.

label: relative volume
definition: Current volume divided by normal volume for the time of day.

label: float
definition: Shares available for public trading.

label: market breadth
definition: Share of stocks participating in a move.

label: duration
definition: Sensitivity of value to interest rates; long-duration assets have distant cash flows.

label: real yield
definition: Nominal yield minus inflation expectations.

label: risk management
definition: Rules that limit losses and control exposure.

label: stop loss
definition: Price or condition at which a losing position is exited.

label: trailing stop
definition: Stop that follows price to lock in gains.
